  • Method Details

    • providerBecameAvailable

      default void providerBecameAvailable(String providerName, String providerId)
      This method will notify when a provider becomes available to connect to it. This method can be called again if the provider ID has changed. This means that the provider has been restarted and needs to be re-connected.

    • providerBecameUnavailable

      default void providerBecameUnavailable(String providerName, String providerId)
